status_at_registration: Before first model evaluation on test_composition or test_length
scope: Evaluation of the same three fixed policies; no additional training or tuning.

test_composition.shift: G major with 4/4, one or two bars; this combination was withheld during training

test_length.shift: Three bars, absent from training; includes both known and withheld key/meter combinations

primary_endpoint: Per-task fraction of four temperature-1 completions satisfying all six constraints, before selection, reported separately for each split.
secondary_endpoints: best-of-four success using the same graded selector
uncertainty: Paired task-level percentile bootstrap, 10000 resamples, seed42; two OOD endpoints reported without multiplicity adjustment. One training seed; no claim of training-seed robustness.
controls: Procedural solver on all tasks; verify adapter checksums before and after. Full splits, no cherry-picking or early stopping based on scores.
failure_policy: Stop on execution errors. Report unfavorable scores. No training changes in response to test results.
